observed.caption: A tall stone monument with bronze statues raising a flag and a sculpted hand holding a dove stands on a stepped platform in an open plaza with several people nearby under a clear blue sky.
observed.description: The image shows a large outdoor stone monument with a tall tapered obelisk tower featuring arched openings at its base, a group of dark bronze statues of several figures raising a flag on a pole atop a tiered stone platform with wide steps, and a large light-colored sculpted hand holding a dove with outstretched wings visible through the tower's arch. The monument sits on a paved plaza surrounded by low hedges and scattered trees under a clear blue sky with a few small birds in flight on the left, illuminated by warm low-angle sunlight casting long shadows, with several people in casual and dark clothing standing on the steps, near the base, and climbing or sitting under the platform's overhang.
